name: Marjolet
description: Marjolet is an elegant two-player card game from southwest France, and the direct ancestor of Bezique and Pinochle. Played with a 32-card French deck, it combines trick-taking with melding, featuring the unique 'Marjolet' (trump Jack) that can be melded with different Queens. The game is known for its tactical depth despite simple rules.

content.text: Marjolet is an elegant two-player card game from southwest France, and the direct ancestor of Bezique and Pinochle. Played with a 32-card French deck, it combines trick-taking with melding, featuring the unique 'Marjolet' (trump Jack) that can be melded with different Queens. The game is known for its tactical depth despite simple rules.
Played in southwest France. The name 'Marjolet' refers to the trump Jack, which has special melding powers. It is the direct ancestor of Bezique and the grandparent of Pinochle.
32-card 'French deck' - remove all cards below 7 from standard deck. Ranking: Ace (high), 10, King, Queen, Jack, 9, 8, 7. Note: 10 is second-highest, right below Ace.
